article.title: Acupuncture and Tuina Combined with Educational Rehabilitation for Children with Autism Spectrum Disorder: Study Protocol for a Single-Center, Three-Arm, Pragmatic Randomized Controlled Trial.
article.authors: Wang X, Dong XQ, Tao YW
article.abstract: The prevalence of autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is increasing globally. While educational rehabilitation is the standard of care, Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) techniques like acupuncture and tuina are widely used in China as adjunctive therapies, but high-quality evidence from rigorous clinical trials remains limited. The objective of this study is to evaluate the efficacy of acupuncture and tuina, combined with educational rehabilitation, for ASD, and to compare the effects of different TCM intervention methods.
